description: This file defines the ModuleClass class for the 'Payslip' module in a vtiger CRM plugin, including properties for database interactions, list views, search, import/export, and module event handling.

classes.name: ModuleClass
classes.description: Represents the Payslip module in vtiger CRM, handling data persistence, list views, sorting, imports, exports, module lifecycle events, and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting columns, database, and log references.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves sorting order preference for listing views.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Determines the field to order list views by.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Placeholder for custom save logic for the module.

methods.name: getQueryByModuleField
methods.description: Returns query for module-specific field filters, used in popup views.

methods.name: getListQuery
methods.description: Constructs the complex SQL query to retrieve list view data for this module.

methods.name: getListViewSecurityParameter
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment for security restrictions based on user privileges.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds the SQL query for exporting records, considering permissions.

methods.name: create_import_query
methods.description: Creates a query to export data for re-import or backup purposes.

methods.name: undo_import
methods.description: Deletes last imported records to undo an import operation.

methods.name: transform_export_value
methods.description: Transforms data values during export, inherited from parent.

methods.name: set_import_assigned_user
methods.description: Assigns the correct user ID during import based on imported data.

methods.name: getDuplicatesQuery
methods.description: Constructs SQL to find duplicate records based on specific fields.

methods.name: vtlib_handler
methods.description: Handles post-install, enable, disable, pre-uninstall, and update events for the module.
